title: Zabbix: Add proxy tasks command support, also improve packet info headers
description:
The "proxy tasks" request from Zabbix server to passive proxy is currently undocumented but is used every second by Zabbix server if `ProxyDataFrequency` configuration directive is changed from the default value of 1.

Also the Info column and the top-level tree texts are made somewhat more uniform and useful.

Sample capture: [zabbix70passiveproxy.pcap](/uploads/6e09585e884b5bb60953ceaac0bc101c/zabbix70passiveproxy.pcap)
